description: At least one reasoning backend is reachable through a policy-driven adapter: codex-cli, agy-cli, grok-cli (Grok Build), grok-api (xAI API via XAI_API_KEY), cursor-cli (Cursor Agent CLI via cursor-agent), opencode-cli (OpenCode CLI via opencode auth login), anthropic, openrouter, nemotron-api, local, Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio, llama.cpp, MLX, LocalAI, or any future adapter registered in the reasoning route policy. The legacy gemini-cli adapter remains available for explicit Enterprise configurations. Stub backend is always available; this manifest distinguishes 'real backend present' from 'falling back to stub'.

capabilities.description: Any of the supported real backends is reachable. Without one, Kyberion runs in stub mode (deterministic placeholders, no LLM output).

install.instruction: Pick one and authenticate it. Recommended for personal use: configure `codex`, `agy` (Antigravity CLI), `grok` (Grok Build CLI via `grok login`), `cursor-agent` (Cursor Agent CLI via `cursor-agent login` / `CURSOR_API_KEY`), or `opencode` (OpenCode CLI via `opencode auth login`). For API providers, register credentials with `pnpm kyberion secret introduce <service-id> API_KEY` (for example `openrouter`, `nemotron`, `anthropic`, `gemini`, or `grok`); OpenAI-compatible local endpoints need URL/model configuration and a key only when the endpoint requires authentication. Then set `KYBERION_REASONING_BACKEND` to the corresponding id (`codex-cli` / `agy-cli` / `grok-cli` / `cursor-cli` / `opencode-cli` / `grok-api` / `anthropic` / `gemini-api` / `openrouter` / `nemotron-api` / `local` / `ollama` / `vllm` / `lmstudio` / `llamacpp` / `mlx` / `localai`; use `gemini-cli` only when intentionally configured). Setting it to `stub` is also valid for offline / deterministic-test deployments.

capabilities.description: Canary for tenant claude CLI runs: the real claude CLI started with the bound-launch env shape (isolated HOME / CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, no credential) must report not logged in, so a tenant run can never fall back to the operator's own login. Runs `claude auth status` only (no model request); satisfied and skipped when claude is not installed.

install.instruction: Isolation is broken: a claude CLI started with an empty isolated CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR still reports a login. Do not run tenant claude work until fixed. Check the installed claude CLI version (`claude --version`) against knowledge/product/orchestration/tenant-task-credential-binding.ja.md (claude CLI isolation) and rerun `pnpm kyberion doctor --manifest reasoning-backend`.

capabilities.description: Lists tenants marked as a person's own tenant (tenant profile personal_owner, set by the owner-approved `pnpm tenant personal-owner`): a person's consumer subscription token (Claude Pro/Max) may serve exactly those tenants. Warns whenever any is set so a company tenant marked personal is visible; satisfied when none is.

install.instruction: Review the listed tenants. Only a person's own tenants (e.g. a home development tenant) may be personal; clear any company or client tenant with `pnpm tenant personal-owner <slug> --clear` (approved by the current personal owner).

capabilities.description: KYBERION_REASONING_BACKEND is set so the bootstrap chooses deterministically rather than auto-discovering on every start.

install.instruction: Set `KYBERION_REASONING_BACKEND` to one of `codex-cli` / `gemini-cli` / `agy-cli` / `grok-cli` / `cursor-cli` / `opencode-cli` / `grok-api` / `anthropic` / `claude-agent` / `openrouter` / `nemotron-api` / `local` / `ollama` / `vllm` / `lmstudio` / `llamacpp` / `mlx` / `localai` / `stub`. Without it, the bootstrap auto-discovers from registered adapters and may pick a different backend across runs. Use `pnpm reasoning:config` to bind roles without changing the global backend; use `pnpm reasoning:config doctor` or Operator Surface `/reasoning` to inspect effective fallback readiness.
